title: Company note frontmatter (v1)
description: Structural contract for findata/Companies/<Sector>/<Name>.md YAML frontmatter. Formalizes the de-facto keys surveyed across the 1,068 live notes (2026-08-17). Relational rules (normalized_name == filename, permalink sector == directory, canonical sector names) stay in helpers/validators/verify_notes.py and static_checks.py; this schema covers structure: key presence, value types, formats and rogue keys.

type.description: Note type discriminator — always 'company' in Companies/.

sector.description: Canonical CAPITALIZED sector name; must equal the parent directory title (relational check).

normalized_name.description: Filename-derived canonical name; MUST match the filename minus .md char-for-char (enforced by verify_notes).

tags.description: Namespaced lowercase tags (prefix/value), e.g. entity_type/company, sector/pharma, market_cap/mid_cap, geography/india.

ticker.description: Exchange ticker, or null when unlisted. Indian: SYMBOL.NS / SYMBOL.BO (NSE/BOM). US: bare uppercase. Never the literal string 'N/A' — use null.

market_cap.description: Cap classification used for tags and search facets, or null when unknown.

industry.description: Optional GICS-style industry description (present on ~87% of notes).

geography.description: Optional lowercase geography tag value (india, usa, global, south_korea, ...).

file_path.description: Legacy vault-relative path recorded by early writers; optional.

listed.description: Optional explicit listing flag (used to record known-unlisted companies).

exchange.description: Optional listing exchange (observed set; extend the schema when a new one appears).

index_membership.description: Dropped key (2026-07-28); tolerated as null on legacy notes, absent on new ones.

isoDate.description: ISO calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD). NOTE: unquoted YAML dates are auto-parsed into date objects by PyYAML; the validator normalizes these to ISO strings before checking.
